latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — automated slideshow creation from your photos or clips.

- Instantly turn up to 20 photos or video clips into a polished 1080p slideshow video, with optional transitions, text, and background music
- Upload images/clips and describe what you want; no manual timeline editing or export settings required
- Fast cloud-based rendering (30–90 seconds for most jobs), with preview and iterative editing supported
- Simple session setup, automatic token management, and support for credits/balance info
- Robust support for multiple formats: jpg, png, mp4, mov, mp3, etc.
- Error handling includes guidance for common issues like expired tokens, missing credits, or unsupported files
